text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: T-T-Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: D-did you see that?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I ran a full... 1,600 meters! And not just
that, I
won!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O used to struggle with
mile
distances... but she's proven it's no
challenge for
her now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However, it's only natural that I've won
today. I
am class representative after all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I always knew I was the can-do type...
but this is a
lot even for me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It's just... simply sublime!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
My talent is blooming at maximum
Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I have just come to a realization!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Do not faint at my words! But it appears
that
after three years of continuous
effort...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I am now able to run an extra 400
meters!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: If I keep on Bakushin-ing at this rate...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, if you divide 3,000 meters by
400
meters... Carry the one...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Anyways! Give me ten years and I'll win
every race
there is!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wait, ten years?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: H-huh? Um... what?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She could win any race if she continues to shoot at this pace... nothing is impossible!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Gasp! You're right!
choice_data_list: A real class rep doesn't sweat the...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho!
choice_data_list: Let's keep this momentum and set o...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh... Ooooh!
choice_data_list: Set your sights on the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's go for it! I want to, without a
doubt!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If I'm with you, Trainer, it'll definitely
happen!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No matter what is ahead, we shall face it

Bakushin-style!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin, BAKUSHIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Nice one! Give me one more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Sakura Bakushin O's journey continues
on!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: BAKUUUSHIIIN!
